name: file-menager
description: Prosty menedżer plików: React SPA + mikroserwisy Express + PostgreSQL + WebSocket

scripts.services: concurrently -n auth,files,activity,gateway -c yellow,blue,magenta,green "node --env-file-if-exists=.env services/auth-service/index.js" "node --env-file-if-exists=.env services/files-service/index.js" "node --env-file-if-exists=.env services/activity-service/index.js" "node --env-file-if-exists=.env services/gateway/index.js"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run services
